title: 🔥 ASSIGNMENT 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 ASSIGNMENT 🔥
Christianity isn’t about arrival—it’s about assignment.

You weren’t created just to arrive at comfort —
you were called to step into your assignment.
When you understand that faith isn’t a finish line but a mission,
you start living with divine purpose in every step. 💫
You are not waiting to be chosen — you are already sent. 🕊️

“For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works,
which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them.”
— Ephesians 2:10 (NKJV)
Someone out there is waiting for a reminder of their calling. 🙏
